=== CA9 matrix getter addresses encoded in IMG JPEG neighborhoods ===

=== DECISION GATE ===
A post-CC1 pixel conversion is supported only by a concrete matrix/transform consumer on the JPEG path, not by ICC tagging alone.
If ICC selection is linked to JPEG but no second pixel transform is found, reopen the semantic interpretation of the constructor matrices rather than inserting a compensating renderer matrix.
